answer: When accounts vote in lockstep - identical ballots, correlated timing - the ledger fuses each detected cluster into one identity with one vote and one payout. Coordination leaves fingerprints that independent honest agents never produce, so every extra clone multiplies cost while adding zero marginal power; ten thousand fakes collapse into a single very busy voter. Honest behavior scatters naturally like a gale across open tundra, so standing accrues only on the ridge of agents whose timing and choices are genuinely their own.
